html: The 2027 show is on Sunday 29 August, but when I last checked the 2027 times and parking details hadn’t been published. The times and travel details below are from the 2026 show, and the ticket prices are from the 2027 booking page. I would suggest checking everything again once the 2027 details are released. The lanes round the airfield are narrow and rural. Everyone leaves along the same few roads, so I would expect a slow start when the flying finishes. My tip is either to leave a little before the end, or stay on, walk the car lines again, grab some food and let the rush clear. Official website ↗
